```{r Student Number Table Tab 4}
names(t_student_number) <- c(
  "State",
  "5-Year Average",
  "2020",
  "2021",
  "2022",
  "2023",
  "2024"
)

t_student <-  datatable(
  t_student_number,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    dom = "t",
    ordering = FALSE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = "dt-left", targets = 0),
      list(className = "dt-right", targets = 1:6)
    )
  ),
  class = "stripe hover compact",
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; color: #355070; font-weight: bold;",
    "Student Numbers by State, 2020–2024"
  )
) |>
  formatRound(
    columns = "5-Year Average",
    digits = 0
  ) |>
  formatRound(
    columns = c("2020", "2021", "2022", "2023", "2024"),
    digits = 0,
    mark = ","
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
    names(t_student_number),
    color = "#355070",
    backgroundColor = "#FFFAF7",
    borderBottom = "1px solid #E8DAD7"
  ) |>
  formatStyle(
    names(t_student_number),
    target = "row",
    backgroundColor = styleEqual(
      t_student_number$State,
      rep("#FFFAF7", nrow(t_student_number))
    )
  )
```

```{r Map Preparation}

)
aus <- aus |>
  filter(name %in% c(
    "New South Wales",
    "Victoria",
    "Queensland",
    "Western Australia",
    "South Australia",
    "Tasmania",
    "Northern Territory",
    "Australian Capital Territory"
  ))

  mutate(State = trimws(gsub("\u00A0", " ", State))) |>

aus_map <- aus |>
```

```{r Rank Bar Chart Tab 1 Interactive}
p_rankbar_plotly <- ggplotly(

p_rankbar_plotly <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_rankbar_plotly,
  "
  function(el, x) {
    const gd = el;

    function getBars() {
      return Array.from(
        gd.querySelectorAll('.barlayer .point')
      );
    }

    function resetBars() {
      getBars().forEach(bar => {
        bar.style.transition =
          'filter 350ms ease, opacity 350ms ease, transform 350ms ease';
        bar.style.filter = '';
        bar.style.opacity = '1';
        bar.style.transform = '';
        bar.style.transformBox = 'fill-box';
        bar.style.transformOrigin = 'center';
      });
    }

    gd.on('plotly_hover', function(event) {
      const point = event.points && event.points[0];
      if (!point) return;

      const bars = getBars();

      // Match the hovered bar using its actual SVG position
      const hoveredY = point.y;

      bars.forEach(bar => {
        const box = bar.getBoundingClientRect();
        const barY = box.top + box.height / 2;

        bar.style.transition =
          'filter 350ms ease, opacity 350ms ease, transform 350ms ease';
        bar.style.transformBox = 'fill-box';
        bar.style.transformOrigin = 'center';

        // Use Plotly's hovered point to identify the bar
        const isSelected =
          Math.abs(barY - event.event.clientY) < box.height / 2 + 8;

        if (isSelected) {
          bar.style.opacity = '1';
          bar.style.filter =
            'brightness(1.2) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(181, 101, 118, 0.55))';
          bar.style.transform = 'scale(1.025)';
        } else {
          bar.style.opacity = '0.35';
          bar.style.filter = '';
          bar.style.transform = '';
        }
      });
    });

    gd.on('plotly_unhover', resetBars);
  }
  "
)
```

```{r Australian Map Tab 1 Interactive}
p_map_plotly <- ggplotly(
  p_map,
  tooltip = "text"
) |>
  layout(
   hoverlabel = list(
  bgcolor = "#FFFAF7",
  bordercolor = "#B56576",
  font = list(
    family = "Arial",
    size = 13,
    color = "#355070"
  ),
  namelength = 0,
  align = "left"
)
  )

for (i in seq_along(p_map_plotly$x$data)) {
  if (identical(p_map_plotly$x$data[[i]]$fill, "toself")) {
    p_map_plotly$x$data[[i]]$hoveron <- "fills"
  }
}

p_map_plotly <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_map_plotly,
  
  "
function(el, x) {
  const gd = el;
  const stateTraces = [];

  gd.data.forEach((trace, i) => {
    if (trace.fill === 'toself' && trace.hoverinfo === 'text') {
      stateTraces.push(i);
      trace.opacity = 1;
    }
  });

  const originalOpacity = stateTraces.map(() => 1);
  let currentState = null;
  let animationFrame = null;

  // Chuyển opacity mượt bằng requestAnimationFrame
  function animateOpacity(selected) {
    if (animationFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);

    const duration = 600;
    const startTime = performance.now();

    const paths = stateTraces.map(i => {
      const traceElement = gd.querySelectorAll(
        '.scatterlayer .trace'
      )[i];

      return traceElement ? traceElement.querySelectorAll('path') : [];
    });

    const startValues = paths.map((pathList, index) => {
      const target = stateTraces[index] === selected ? 1 : 0.25;
      const path = pathList[0];
      const current = path ? parseFloat(getComputedStyle(path).opacity) : 1;
      return Number.isFinite(current) ? current : target;
    });

    function step(now) {
      const progress = Math.min((now - startTime) / duration, 1);
      const eased = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress);

      paths.forEach((pathList, index) => {
        const target = stateTraces[index] === selected ? 1 : 0.25;
        const opacity = startValues[index] +
          (target - startValues[index]) * eased;

        pathList.forEach(path => {
          path.style.opacity = opacity;
        });
      });

      if (progress < 1) {
        animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        animationFrame = null;
      }
    }

    animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function resetMap() {
    currentState = null;

    if (animationFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
    animationFrame = null;

    gd.querySelectorAll('.scatterlayer .trace path').forEach(path => {
      path.style.opacity = '';
      path.style.filter = '';
    });

    Plotly.restyle(gd, {opacity: originalOpacity}, stateTraces);
  }

  gd.on('plotly_hover', function(event) {
    const point = event.points && event.points[0];

    if (!point || !stateTraces.includes(point.curveNumber)) return;

    const selected = point.curveNumber;
    if (currentState === selected) return;
    currentState = selected;

    animateOpacity(selected);

    const traceElement = gd.querySelectorAll(
      '.scatterlayer .trace'
    )[selected];

    if (traceElement) {
      traceElement.querySelectorAll('path').forEach(path => {
        path.style.filter =
          'brightness(1.2) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(181, 101, 118, 0.8))';
      });
    }
  });

  gd.on('plotly_unhover', resetMap);
}
"
  
)
```

```{r Treemap Chart Tab 1 Interactive}
      font = list(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 13,
        color = "#FFFFFF"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  
htmlwidgets::onRender("
function(el, x) {
  const gd = el;
  const palette = [
    '#EAAC8B',
    '#E56B6F',
    '#B56576',
    '#6D597A',
    '#355070'
  ];

  function getTiles() {
    return Array.from(
      gd.querySelectorAll('.treemaplayer .trace .slice')
    );
  }

  function getTileColor(tile) {
    const path = tile.querySelector('path');
    return path
      ? getComputedStyle(path).fill.toLowerCase()
      : '';
  }

  function resetTiles() {
    getTiles().forEach(tile => {
      tile.style.transition =
        'filter 650ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 650ms ease';
      tile.style.filter = '';
      tile.style.opacity = '1';
    });
  }

  gd.on('plotly_hover', function(event) {
    const point = event.points && event.points[0];
    if (!point) return;

    const tiles = getTiles();
    const selectedTile = tiles[point.pointNumber];
    if (!selectedTile) return;

    const selectedColor = getTileColor(selectedTile);

    tiles.forEach(tile => {
      tile.style.transition =
        'filter 650ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 650ms ease';

      const sameColor = getTileColor(tile) === selectedColor;

      if (sameColor) {
        tile.style.opacity = '1';
        tile.style.filter =
          'brightness(1.22) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(181,101,118,0.65))';
      } else {
        tile.style.opacity = '0.72';
        tile.style.filter = '';
      }
    });
  });

  gd.on('plotly_unhover', resetTiles);
}
")

```



```{r Dodge Bar Chart Tab 2 Interactive}
C_dodge_plot <- C_dodge |>
  mutate(
    Period = trimws(as.character(Period)),
    Equity_Group = as.character(Equity_Group)
  ) |>
  group_by(Period) |>
  mutate(Period_Avg = mean(Average_Participation, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    Period = factor(
      Period,
      levels = unique(
        Period[order(Period_Avg)]
      )
    ),
    Hover = paste0(
      "<b>", Equity_Group, "</b>",
      "<br>Period: ", Period,
      "<br>Average Participation: ",
      round(Average_Participation, 2), "%"

  )

# Convert to Plotly for interactive hover
p_dodge_plotly <- ggplotly(
  p_dodge,
  tooltip = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    autosize = TRUE,
    paper_bgcolor = "#FFFAF7",
    plot_bgcolor = "#FFFAF7",
    height = 350,
    margin = list(l = 55, r = 15, t = 20, b = 55),
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#355070",
      bordercolor = "#B56576",
      font = list(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12,
        color = "#FFFFFF"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      const gd = el;

      function getTraces() {
        return Array.from(
          gd.querySelectorAll('.barlayer .trace')
        );
      }

      function resetBars() {
        getTraces().forEach(trace => {
          trace.querySelectorAll('.point').forEach(bar => {
            bar.style.transition =
              'filter 500ms ease, opacity 500ms ease, transform 500ms ease';
            bar.style.filter = '';
            bar.style.opacity = '1';
            bar.style.transform = '';
            bar.style.transformBox = 'fill-box';
            bar.style.transformOrigin = 'center';
          });
        });
      }

      gd.on('plotly_hover', function(event) {
        const point = event.points && event.points[0];
        if (!point) return;

        const traces = getTraces();

        traces.forEach((trace, traceIndex) => {
          trace.querySelectorAll('.point').forEach(bar => {
            bar.style.transition =
              'filter 500ms ease, opacity 500ms ease, transform 500ms ease';
            bar.style.transformBox = 'fill-box';
            bar.style.transformOrigin = 'center';

            if (traceIndex === point.curveNumber) {
              bar.style.opacity = '1';
              bar.style.filter =
                'brightness(1.18) drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(181,101,118,0.65))';
              bar.style.transform = 'scale(1.025)';
            } else {
              bar.style.opacity = '0.25';
              bar.style.filter = '';
              bar.style.transform = '';
            }
          });
        });
      });

      gd.on('plotly_unhover', resetBars);
    }
  ")
```

```{r Line Chart Tab 2}
p_line_plotly <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_line_plotly,
  '
  function(el, x) {
    const gd = el;

    function getTraces() {
      return gd.querySelectorAll(".scatterlayer .trace");
    }

    function resetChart() {
      getTraces().forEach(function(trace) {
        trace.style.transition =
          "opacity 250ms ease, filter 250ms ease";
        trace.style.opacity = "1";
        trace.style.filter = "none";
      });
    }

    function highlightTrace(activeTrace) {
      getTraces().forEach(function(trace) {
        trace.style.transition =
          "opacity 250ms ease, filter 250ms ease";

        if (trace === activeTrace) {
          trace.style.opacity = "1";
          trace.style.filter =
            "drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(181,101,118,0.55))";
        } else {
          trace.style.opacity = "0.15";
          trace.style.filter = "none";
        }
      });
    }

    function bindLineHover() {
      getTraces().forEach(function(trace) {
        const lines = trace.querySelectorAll(".js-line");

        lines.forEach(function(line) {
          line.style.pointerEvents = "stroke";
          line.style.cursor = "pointer";

          line.addEventListener("mouseenter", function() {
            highlightTrace(trace);
          });

          line.addEventListener("mouseleave", function() {
            resetChart();
          });
        });
      });
    }

    gd.on("plotly_afterplot", bindLineHover);

    gd.on("plotly_hover", function(eventData) {
      if (!eventData.points || !eventData.points.length) return;

      const index = eventData.points[0].curveNumber;
      const traces = getTraces();

      if (traces[index]) {
        highlightTrace(traces[index]);
      }
    });

    gd.on("plotly_unhover", resetChart);

    bindLineHover();
  }
  '
)
```

```{r Donut Chart Interactive}
        slices.forEach(function(slice) {
          slice.style.opacity = '1';
          slice.style.filter = 'none';
          slice.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease';
        });
      }

      gd.on('plotly_hover', function(e) {
        if (!e.points || !e.points.length) return;

        var selected = e.points[0].pointNumber;
        var slices = gd.querySelectorAll('.slice');

        slices.forEach(function(slice, i) {
          slice.style.transition = 'all 0.2s ease';

          if (i === selected) {
            slice.style.opacity = '1';
            slice.style.filter =
              'drop-shadow(0px 0px 7px rgba(181,101,118,0.9))';
          } else {
            slice.style.opacity = '0.22';
            slice.style.filter = 'none';
          }
        });
      });

      gd.on('plotly_unhover', resetSlices);
    }
  ")
```

```{r Dumbell Chart Tab 3}
p_dumbbell_plotly <- plotly::ggplotly(
  p_dumbbell,
  tooltip = "text"
) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var gd = document.getElementById(el.id);

      var originalSizes = gd.data.map(function(trace) {
        if (!trace.marker) return null;
        return Array.isArray(trace.marker.size)
          ? trace.marker.size.slice()
          : (trace.marker.size || 10);
      });

      var originalColors = gd.data.map(function(trace) {
        return trace.marker ? trace.marker.color : null;
      });

      var busy = false;

      function resetPoints() {
        if (busy) return;
        gd.data.forEach(function(trace, i) {
          if (!trace.marker || originalSizes[i] === null) return;
          Plotly.restyle(gd, {
            'marker.size': [originalSizes[i]]
          }, [i]);
        });

        gd.querySelectorAll('.scatterlayer .trace path').forEach(function(node) {
          node.style.filter = 'none';
          node.style.transition = 'filter 450ms ease';
        });
      }

      gd.on('plotly_hover', function(e) {
        if (!e.points || !e.points.length || busy) return;

        var point = e.points[0];
        var targetColor = originalColors[point.curveNumber];

        gd.data.forEach(function(trace, i) {
          if (!trace.marker || originalSizes[i] === null) return;

          var sameColor = originalColors[i] === targetColor;
          var size = originalSizes[i];

          var newSize = Array.isArray(size)
            ? size.map(function(s) {
                return sameColor ? s * 1.12 : s;
              })
            : size * (sameColor ? 1.12 : 1);

          Plotly.restyle(gd, {
            'marker.size': [newSize]
          }, [i]);
        });

        gd.querySelectorAll('.scatterlayer .trace').forEach(function(trace, i) {
          trace.querySelectorAll('.points path').forEach(function(node) {
            node.style.transition = 'filter 450ms ease';
            node.style.filter =
              originalColors[i] === targetColor
                ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(102, 84, 119, 0.65))'
                : 'none';
          });
        });
      });

      gd.on('plotly_unhover', resetPoints);
    }
  ") |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        '<b>Employment Outcomes by Educational Attainment</b>',
        '<br><span style=\"font-size:12px;color:#6D597A\">With vs without a non-school qualification</span>'
      ),
      x = 0,
      xanchor = 'left',
      y = 0.94,
      yanchor = 'top',
      font = list(
        family = 'Arial',
        size = 17,
        color = '#355070'
      )
```

```{r Stacked Chart Preparation Tab 3 }
IJK_period <- IJK_gap |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Period = dplyr::case_when(
      Year >= 2016 & Year <= 2017 ~ "2016–2017",
      Year >= 2018 & Year <= 2019 ~ "2018–2019",
      Year >= 2020 & Year <= 2021 ~ "2020–2021",
      Year >= 2022 & Year <= 2023 ~ "2022–2023",
      Year >= 2024 & Year <= 2025 ~ "2024–2025"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Period, Course.Type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Domestic = mean(Domestic, na.rm = TRUE),
    International = mean(International, na.rm = TRUE),
    Employment_Gap = mean(Employment_Gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Period = factor(
      Period,
      levels = c(
        "2016–2017",
        "2018–2019",
        "2020–2021",
        "2022–2023",
        "2024–2025"

  )

  dplyr::mutate(

      levels = c("Employment_Gap", "International"),

    )
```
```{r p_undergrad_plotly Creation Tab 3}
  )

p_undergrad_plotly <- ggplotly(
  p_undergrad,
  tooltip = "none"
) |>
 htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var gd = document.getElementById(el.id);
      var svg = gd.querySelector('svg.main-svg');
      if (!svg) return;

      var ns = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
      var defs = svg.querySelector('defs');

      if (!defs) {
        defs = document.createElementNS(ns, 'defs');
        svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
      }

      // Remove previous filter if this widget is re-rendered
      var old = svg.querySelector('#undergradGlowStrong');
      if (old) old.remove();

      // Layered mauve glow
      var filter = document.createElementNS(ns, 'filter');
      filter.setAttribute('id', 'undergradGlowStrong');
      filter.setAttribute('x', '-100%');
      filter.setAttribute('y', '-60%');
      filter.setAttribute('width', '300%');
      filter.setAttribute('height', '220%');
      filter.setAttribute('color-interpolation-filters', 'sRGB');

      var blur1 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feGaussianBlur');
      blur1.setAttribute('in', 'SourceGraphic');
      blur1.setAttribute('stdDeviation', '3');
      blur1.setAttribute('result', 'blur1');

      var color1 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feFlood');
      color1.setAttribute('flood-color', '#C4A7B5');
      color1.setAttribute('flood-opacity', '0.95');
      color1.setAttribute('result', 'glowColor1');

      var comp1 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feComposite');
      comp1.setAttribute('in', 'glowColor1');
      comp1.setAttribute('in2', 'blur1');
      comp1.setAttribute('operator', 'in');
      comp1.setAttribute('result', 'glow1');

      var blur2 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feGaussianBlur');
      blur2.setAttribute('in', 'SourceGraphic');
      blur2.setAttribute('stdDeviation', '6');
      blur2.setAttribute('result', 'blur2');

      var color2 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feFlood');
      color2.setAttribute('flood-color', '#DCC6D5');
      color2.setAttribute('flood-opacity', '0.55');
      color2.setAttribute('result', 'glowColor2');

      var comp2 = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feComposite');
      comp2.setAttribute('in', 'glowColor2');
      comp2.setAttribute('in2', 'blur2');
      comp2.setAttribute('operator', 'in');
      comp2.setAttribute('result', 'glow2');

      var merge = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feMerge');

      ['glow2', 'glow1', 'SourceGraphic'].forEach(function(input) {
        var node = document.createElementNS(ns, 'feMergeNode');
        node.setAttribute('in', input);
        merge.appendChild(node);
      });

      filter.appendChild(blur1);
      filter.appendChild(color1);
      filter.appendChild(comp1);
      filter.appendChild(blur2);
      filter.appendChild(color2);
      filter.appendChild(comp2);
      filter.appendChild(merge);
      defs.appendChild(filter);

      function groupName(name) {
        name = (name || '').toLowerCase();

        if (name.indexOf('international') >= 0) return 'international';
        if (name.indexOf('employment gap') >= 0 ||
            name.indexOf('employment_gap') >= 0) return 'gap';

        return null;
      }

      function setBars(group) {
        gd.querySelectorAll('.barlayer .trace').forEach(function(trace) {
          var traces = Array.from(trace.parentNode.children);
          var index = traces.indexOf(trace);
          var data = gd.data[index];
          var currentGroup = groupName(data && data.name);
          var selected = group && currentGroup === group;

          trace.querySelectorAll('path').forEach(function(bar) {
            bar.style.transition =
              'opacity 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), ' +
              'filter 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';

            if (selected) {
              bar.style.opacity = '1';
              bar.style.filter = 'url(#undergradGlowStrong)';
            } else if (group && currentGroup) {
              bar.style.opacity = '0.20';
              bar.style.filter = 'none';
            } else {
              bar.style.opacity = '1';
              bar.style.filter = 'none';
            }
          });
        });
      }

      gd.on('plotly_hover', function(eventData) {
        if (!eventData.points || !eventData.points.length) return;

        var group = groupName(eventData.points[0].data.name);
        if (group) setBars(group);
      });

      gd.on('plotly_unhover', function() {
        setBars(null);
      });
    }
  ")

p_undergrad_plotly <- p_undergrad_plotly |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = paste0(
        "Undergraduate Employment Rates",
        "<br><sup>International employment rate + gap to domestic graduates</sup>"
      ),
      x = 0,
      xanchor = "left",
      font = list(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 18,
        color = "#355070"
      )
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = list(text = ""),
      tickfont = list(size = 10, color = "#355070"),
      automargin = TRUE
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = list(
        text = "Employment rate (%)",
        font = list(size = 10, color = "#355070")
      ),
      tickfont = list(size = 9, color = "#355070"),
      automargin = TRUE
    ),
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      x = 0.5,
      xanchor = "center",
      y = -0.18,
      font = list(size = 9, color = "#355070")
    ),
    margin = list(t = 85, b = 65, l = 55, r = 20)
  )
```

```{r Salary Area Chart Tab 3}
p_salary_interactive <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  p_salary_interactive,
"
  function(el, x) {
    const gd = document.getElementById(el.id);

    function setupGlow() {
      const svg = gd.querySelector('.main-svg');
      if (!svg) return;

      let defs = svg.querySelector('defs');
      if (!defs) {
        defs = document.createElementNS(
          'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'defs'
        );
        svg.prepend(defs);
      }

      if (!svg.querySelector('#salaryGlow')) {
        const filter = document.createElementNS(
          'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'filter'
        );
        filter.setAttribute('id', 'salaryGlow');
        filter.setAttribute('x', '-60%');
        filter.setAttribute('y', '-60%');
        filter.setAttribute('width', '220%');
        filter.setAttribute('height', '220%');

        const blur = document.createElementNS(
          'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'feGaussianBlur'
        );
        blur.setAttribute('stdDeviation', '4');
        blur.setAttribute('result', 'blur');

        const merge = document.createElementNS(
          'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'feMerge'
        );

        ['blur', 'SourceGraphic'].forEach(name => {
          const node = document.createElementNS(
            'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'feMergeNode'
          );
          node.setAttribute('in', name);
          merge.appendChild(node);
        });

        filter.appendChild(blur);
        filter.appendChild(merge);
        defs.appendChild(filter);
      }

      gd.querySelectorAll('.scatterlayer .trace .js-line')
        .forEach(line => {
          // Lưu độ dày gốc duy nhất một lần
          if (!line.dataset.originalWidth) {
            line.dataset.originalWidth =
              line.style.strokeWidth ||
              line.getAttribute('stroke-width') ||
              '2';
          }

          if (line.dataset.glowReady) return;
          line.dataset.glowReady = '1';

          const originalWidth = line.dataset.originalWidth;

          line.style.transition =
            'stroke-width 220ms ease, filter 220ms ease';
          line.style.pointerEvents = 'stroke';

          line.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
            line.style.filter = 'url(#salaryGlow)';
            line.style.strokeWidth =
              (parseFloat(originalWidth) + 1.5) + 'px';
          });

          line.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
            line.style.filter = 'none';
            line.style.strokeWidth = originalWidth;
          });
        });
    }

    setupGlow();
    gd.on('plotly_afterplot', setupGlow);
  }
  "
)
```

# Data Source & Statistic

## Overview {.sidebar}

**Overview**

---

This dashboard presents statistics and Data on education in Australia.

---

**Coverage**

States and Territories: 8  
Study Period: 2016 – 2025

---

**Key Concepts**

**Educational Inequality**: Differences in access to educational opportunities and resources across student groups.

**Educational Quality**: The quality of learning experiences and educational outcomes.

**Educational Outcomes**: The achievements and opportunities students gain through education.

---

**Data Source**

**Higher Education Student Data**

[Department of Education — 2024 Student Data](https://www.education.gov.au/higher-education-statistics/student-data/selected-higher-education-statistics-2024-student-data)

**Education and Work**

[Australian Bureau of Statistics — May 2025](https://www.abs.gov.au/statistics/people/education/education-and-work-australia/may-2025#data-downloads)

**Graduate Outcomes & Student Experience**

[QILT Resources](https://www.qilt.edu.au/resources)

---
